note: Reviewed list of host systemd USER units that the release installs itself (scripts/install_staged_units.py, called by scripts/cio_phase2_exact_main_deploy.sh promote after the bound-unit restart). A group is installed only when its admission config says enabled + REVIEWED, only after its dry-run succeeded (AGENTS rule 7), and replaced copies are archived, never deleted. Adding a group here is a [shared-infra] change: it puts a new scheduled unit on the host at the next release with no operator step. Rollback: scripts/install_staged_units.py rollback --release <dir> (disable --now + archive).

groups.why: Independent cron/wrapper outage watchdog (docs/ops/packets/cron-outage-prevention-20261024 section 6). Host timer by design, not n8n: the alert path must not depend on what it watches.

once.why: The coordinator's own real-layout safe_flock proof (rl3, 2026-10-25) wrote one refusal into the production journal. It is not a lane; acknowledge it once so the first live run does not page for it.
argv: agent real-layout proof, not a lane
